confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Kenyan coastal tourist pricing; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season and location. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the local beer relationship (about 2.2 to 2.4 times beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from a web search summary of the RBA's rba.gov.au exchange-rate pages; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on coastal East African tourist pricing (Dar es Salaam and Zanzibar) and Nairobi restaurant pricing, adjusted for Mombasa's beach-resort and budget-hostel market.
